researchId.title: Research ID
researchId.description: The off-core research job ID for the completed research run whose report should be surfaced. If not provided, the action retrieves it from the current Knowledge Space session.

deepResearchWorkflowAction.title: Deep Research Workflow Action
deepResearchWorkflowAction.description: Workflow action identifier — must be VIEW_REPORT for this action. Set automatically by the LEX client when the run-research polling loop detects a completed report.
